selection: Highest calibration macro-F1, then agreement, then smaller artifact. Existing test is reused only for descriptive comparison after selection; prior E5 test has already been seen.
temperature_calibration: Minimize calibration NLL over [0.25,4]; keep 1 if no improvement.

finetune.condition: Requested frozen and supervised backbone comparison
finetune.selection: Highest calibration macro-F1, then agreement; evaluate only after each complete epoch.

comparison_scope: Full existing train/calibration, same teacher and splits, dense embeddings only. Same 512-token complete-text windowing as E5; native 8192-token context is not tested. Effective batch 32 documents. No new Qwen calls.
